commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text:
The first nonlegendary artifact spell you cast each turn has casualty 2. (As you cast it, you may sacrifice a creature with power 2 or greater. When you do, copy it. A copy of an artifact spell becomes a token.)
Whenever you sacrifice another creature, put a +1/+1 counter on Ashad.

source_basis.known_approval_project_exceptions: Explicit user approval after corrected Oracle review, full 99-slot audit, candidate exhaustion, red-team review, and zero-new-material-improvement closure.

strategy.primary: Artifact-copy value: make the first nonlegendary artifact spell each turn a two-for-one by sacrificing a power-2+ creature (often an artifact creature or token), growing Ashad with every sacrifice; flash artifacts extend 'first each turn' to opponents' turns.
strategy.secondary: Artifact-sacrifice drains and recursion (Disciple of the Vault, Mayhem Devil, KCI, altars, Scrap Trawler, Goblin Welder), and the Urza + Worldwalker Helm + Artificer Class infinite.

role.advances_plan: Ashad copies one artifact spell per turn into a token and turns every sacrifice into a counter on himself.
role.honest_note: Once per turn and only nonlegendary artifact spells; the deck's artifact-sacrifice core (KCI, altars, Urza) would run under any Grixis artifact commander. Ashad is a strong value engine, not the deck's sole win source.

identity_core.why: Turns the first artifact spell each turn into a free token copy.
Core multiplier: each casualty copy becomes two.
Flash for artifacts uses 'first each turn' on every opponent's turn too.
Artifact casts make 3/1 Dinosaurs: casualty fodder that also makes Treasure.
Both fodder and copy target; each copy ramps and later draws.
